name: MomentumLadder
preConditionHook:
// MomentumLadder (Brian's notes ON-54, #54): close > close[X] > close[2X] >
// close[4X], X = stepBars, strict at every link. Short mirrors (descending).
longCondition: el_gt(close[0], close[(int)stepBars]) && el_gt(close[(int)stepBars], close[(int)(2 * stepBars)]) && el_gt(close[(int)(2 * stepBars)], close[(int)(4 * stepBars)])
shortCondition: el_lt(close[0], close[(int)stepBars]) && el_lt(close[(int)stepBars], close[(int)(2 * stepBars)]) && el_lt(close[(int)(2 * stepBars)], close[(int)(4 * stepBars)])
